text: A股三大股指今早集体开涨，创业板指开盘涨超1%，随后盘中涨幅震荡收窄。截至午盘收盘，沪指收涨0.46%，深证成指收涨0.27%，创业板指收涨0.56%，科创50收涨0.7%。两市成交额超1万亿元，全市场超2650只个股上涨。板块方面，煤炭、航天装备、元件、光纤概念等板块涨幅居前。旅游零售、储能概念、电池等板块逆市走低。
text_en: A-shares' three major stock indices all opened higher this morning. The ChiNext Index opened up more than 1% and then narrowed its gains amid volatility. As of the midday close, the Shanghai Composite Index was up 0.46%, the Shenzhen Component Index was up 0.27%, the ChiNext Index was up 0.56%, and the STAR 50 was up 0.7%. Turnover in the two markets exceeded RMB 1 trillion, and more than 2,650 stocks rose across the market. By sector, coal, aerospace equipment, components, optical fiber concepts and other sectors led the gains. Tourism retail, energy storage concepts, batteries and other sectors bucked the trend and fell.
